data.title: Playful Illustration
data.tagline: Use distinctive character, shape, and feedback to make a product feel friendly and alive
data.description: Playful illustration is a visual direction that builds brand character through illustrated people, scenes, and exaggerated forms; it is more specific than using bright color or large rounded corners. It often pairs with expressive but clear typography and light motion, working well for learning, creative, and young consumer products. Illustration cannot excuse weak information or unclear interaction states.

use: Learning, creator, and lightweight productivity products that want a welcoming first experience
Younger consumer and community brands where personality and warmth are meaningful differences
Products with a mascot or illustration system that can support onboarding, empty states, and feedback
Tasks that commonly create anxiety , where gentle language and positive response can reduce pressure
avoid: Make every element bounce, rotate, and change color ; constant interruption erases priority
Confuse childish treatment with friendliness ; adults enjoy lightness without being spoken down to
Use bright text with weak contrast ; vivid surfaces still need a stable reading layer
Answer serious outcomes only with emoji ; payment, access, and errors still require precise explanation

data.agentPrompt: Playful illustration product website, controlled yellow, violet, and green palette, rounded expressive headline, original geometric characters, scenes, and sticker elements, clear buttons and task cards, elastic but restrained feedback, friendly without becoming childish
